data.name: Time Greeting Pipeline
data.description: Fetches current time, generates a greeting via LLM, and exports as JSON.
example_prompts: Create a greeting with current time

arguments.prompt: Create a one-line friendly greeting that incorporates this timestamp: {{fetch_time.datetime}}. Make it natural and conversational.
arguments.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant that creates brief, friendly greetings.

suggestions: Ensure the generate_greeting node's LLM prompt explicitly requests a one-line greeting based on the current time (e.g., 'Create a one-line greeting based on this timestamp: {{fetch_time.__all__}}')
Verify data_exporter node is configured with JSON output format and includes the greeting from {{generate_greeting.__all__}}
validation_issues: No explicit verification that the LLM prompt instructs it to create a 'one-line greeting' from the timestamp
No confirmation that data_exporter is configured to output JSON format specifically
